instruction: Transform the "Meeting-Agenda.docx" file from the Desktop into a PDF document and upload the converted file to the meetings folder in Google Drive.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting Meeting-Agenda.docx to PDF and uploading to Google Drive. Evaluator checks if the PDF is valid and contains at least 100 characters of text (verifying content was properly converted).
metadata.verification: Verified that the meeting agenda document contains substantial text content (meeting details, attendees, agenda items) that should result in a PDF with at least 100 characters of extractable text.

Expected value is semantically correct: 100-character threshold is appropriate for meeting agenda document content validation
